read.thesis: Quanta raised FY26 guidance (revenue $34.7-35.2B, adj. EBITDA $3.49-3.65B, adj. EPS $13.55-14.25) on record $48.5B backlog and a $500-700M transformer capacity doubling, though no supply-discipline or pricing data was given.

capex.quote: CapEx went up, but it only went up by like $50 million at the midpoint

triggers.label: Adj. EPS guide raised to $13.55-14.25
triggers.quote: adjusted EPS to range between $13.55 and $14.25

triggers.label: Transformer capacity to double, $500-700M
triggers.quote: which will double our power transformer manufacturing capacity

guidance.value: 15%-20% annually; more than double earnings power by 2030
$500 million range (unchanged), tracking toward higher end

prior_guidance_check.quote: Management reiterated an ongoing $500 million to $700 million multi-year capital program
We gave a good range when we guided in the fourth quarter about our free cash flow

red_flags.label: Revenue/EPS guide raise smaller than Q1 beat
red_flags.quote: We took forward our beat in the first quarter

red_flags.label: Guidance conservatism asserted, not quantified
red_flags.quote: Our guidance is prudent. It has always been prudent.

evasions.topic: EPS guide raise vs Q1 beat math
evasions.quote: I'm not following that math, Phil, I'll admit.
that's directional. And if it was up to me, I wouldn't have that slide.
